testOnlyAdaptations: Both isolated benchmark snapshots raise manifest limits to the exact US counts and permit 1,300 chunks.
Both use an 8,192-wide event texture in the experiment; production limits and width are unchanged.
The harness hides HTML markers and tips; complete app effects and interactions are covered by the browser suite.
Graphs are served locally; opening network latency is not measured.
timingCaution: renderFinish timing fields in exploratory reports are not reliable GPU measurements and are excluded from conclusions. An instrumented repeat of the Chromium baseline suffered synchronization-related slowdowns and is excluded. Ordinary playback records are retained; overview variation is not claimed as a speedup.
